nonInferioritySemantics.assessmentInstability: maximum acceptable B-to-C increase; lower is better
nonInferioritySemantics.falseMergeRate: maximum acceptable B-to-C increase; upper work-family-bootstrap confidence bound must not exceed the margin

missingDataPolicy.documentLevel: Every document in the frozen confirmatory holdout must have A, B, and C exports before the confirmatory analysis is complete; documents may not be removed after outputs are opened.
missingDataPolicy.goldLevel: Unusable occurrences must be rejected before gold freeze and frozen gold must contain zero unreviewed occurrences.
missingDataPolicy.modelOutputLevel: Ambiguous, unresolved, null, or otherwise absent lexical resolution produced by a checkpoint is a model outcome, not missing data, and remains in the frozen occurrence denominator.

retryPolicy.allowed: Infrastructure-only failures may be rerun with the identical frozen source/sample, checkpoint revision, experiment harness, and runtime policy.
retryPolicy.forbidden: Linguistic/model failures, poor metrics, difficult documents, or unfavorable checkpoint differences are not retry reasons.
retryPolicy.provenanceFailure: Hash, range, or provenance failures must be investigated and regenerated from the frozen source inputs; they must not be repaired by changing gold or the frozen sample after checkpoint outputs are opened.

stoppingEnrollmentRule.automaticSplitAdequacyTargetMeaning: Practical evidence-resolution target for predicted automatic split decisions overall; it is not an adaptive stopping trigger.
stoppingEnrollmentRule.documentEnrollment: Run every document in the frozen confirmatory holdout through every planned checkpoint; do not add, remove, or replace documents based on partial results.
stoppingEnrollmentRule.ifAdequacyTargetIsMissed: Report insufficient automatic-split decision support from this frozen holdout; do not supplement the same holdout after checkpoint outputs are opened.
